issues.title: Deliver first organization-to-installation slice
issues.body: Local first increment: login, memberships, operator policy, contacts/scope review, manual asset outbox, software and evidence UI/API. Validate tests and docs; track delivered status in docs/validation.md.

issues.title: Validate central NetBox against an isolated live tenant
issues.body: Bundled official NetBox v4.7.3 / netbox-docker 5.1.1 has now been exercised live with tenant-scoped read-only and read/write v2 tokens, devices/VMs/IPs/prefixes, portal writes, upstream write denial and lost-ack recovery. External-mode connectivity to this isolated reference backend is validated too. Remaining: independently deployed instances/versions and legacy authentication, broader site/type/role mappings and operational key policies; no production inventory.

issues.title: Implement complete NetBox source refresh and reconciliation
issues.body: Implemented: devices, VMs, IP addresses and prefixes import atomically after complete scoped pagination; periodic scheduling, queued manual refresh, per-source freshness/errors/counts and source links; missing objects retained with explicit review and reappearance; local software/findings/assessments preserved; source locks serialize import and write-ack recovery. Contract and PostgreSQL concurrency tests plus live bundled integration validate the bounded four-type importer. Strong upstream snapshots, broader topology and monitored production scheduling remain distinct work.

issues.title: Harden operator-assisted onboarding and product normalization
issues.body: Account/membership lifecycle, contact validation and history, explicit product identity normalization, network/service inventory topology, database tenant integrity, source binding migration controls.

issues.title: Support multi-instance NetBox queries and access modes
issues.body: Implemented named instances with credential references, read-only/read-write/disabled capabilities, shared tenant and dedicated organization scope, safe pagination for devices/VMs/IPs/prefixes, GET-only multi-source query runner, independent read health, UI/job write restrictions, migrations and isolation tests. No automatic import or inter-instance synchronization; live compatibility remains tracked separately.

issues.title: Provide a bundled NetBox development stack and external starter
issues.body: Deliver Docker/Python starter with official pinned NetBox, scoped read/write and read-only synthetic tenants, generated credentials and verified TLS, a Bearings worker, repeatable provisioning and preserved volumes. Provide external read-only-by-default configuration without remote writes during bootstrap, private key handling, real functional smoke tests and CI. General inventory import remains separate. Implemented in 06f99a5 with smoke identity guard 3bb32e7. Docker prerequisite diagnostics now explain missing CLI, Compose and engine availability before changing active lab state. Full default startup, live smoke and retained-volume restart passed: https://github.com/rommelfs/bearings/actions/runs/38883987302 . Checks passed 75 tests per database: https://github.com/rommelfs/bearings/actions/runs/38883987223 . External wiring was validated against the pinned reference backend; general inventory import remains separate.

title: M2: Correlation
description: Add evidence-backed intelligence without unsafe inference

issues.title: Validate live Vulnerability-Lookup and canonical aliases
issues.body: Live public CVE retrieval and persisted evidence are validated. Immutable content-addressed source revisions now support pinned MOSP/MONARC scenario links, and refresh preserves operator redistribution restrictions. Remaining: canonical aliases, deployed service version, broader source-specific adapters and freshness health. No automatic applicability is claimed.

issues.title: Connect NetBox assets, Vulnerability-Lookup evidence and MOSP risk scenarios
issues.body: Implemented public CC0 MONARC catalog retrieval through MOSP v2; strict publisher/schema/identity/language/licensing and bounded complete pagination; retained source health and missing records; explicit justified organization-local links with pinned CVE and risk/asset/threat/general-weakness revisions, withdrawal history, joined HTML/API views and current visibility enforcement. Validated live synthetic NetBox → live CVE → live catalog chain, real authenticated HTTP view/API/evidence, final retained-image restart, 114 PostgreSQL tests and 112 SQLite passes plus two PostgreSQL-only skips. Checks 38910631336 and complete bundled lifecycle 38910631286 passed for ceabb90. No automated affectedness, risk score or MONARC assessment synchronization.

issues.title: Implement explicit product/version applicability
issues.body: Use supported structured source capabilities; preserve unknown versions, vendor fixes, backports and configuration requirements. Keep severity, EPSS, catalog membership, exploitation sightings and applicability distinct.

issues.title: Implement MISP ingestion with redistribution policy
issues.body: Inspect selected release API, paginate/retry safely, preserve event/object roles and markings. Enforce distribution, sharing groups and operator policy for raw and derived data. Test default-deny behavior and common origins.

issues.title: Implement Plum Island historical observation adapter
issues.body: Verify authentication/permissions/schema and InfoIP time/404/empty semantics. Preserve tcp/udp, report-level tags, hostname context and uncertainty. Investigate network/domain export; never enumerate large ranges blindly or launch scans.

issues.title: Generalize observations, relationships and explained priorities
issues.body: Keep categories and assessment dimensions distinct. Match historical/shared claims, preserve rule versions, observation/ingestion/evaluation times, evidence provenance and independent origins.

issues.title: Deliver controlled notification and escalation workflow
issues.body: Keep development sink; require operational authorization for production transport. Add delivery failure state, reminder escalation, deduplication, handling policy and audited preparation history.

issues.title: Complete organization remediation and CIRCL triage
issues.body: Review filters, acknowledgment/corrections, assignment, urgency summaries and freshness coverage. Test all counts/exports/notifications against visibility restrictions.

issues.title: Security and recovery gate before deployment
issues.body: SSO/MFA, rate limits, source approval/egress enforcement, DB row-level integrity, least privilege, audit export, retention and PostgreSQL recovery drill. Approve WSGI/TLS configuration and production scheduler.

issues.title: Complete security contact and release governance
issues.body: AGPL-3.0-or-later and public source publication are approved. Establish a verified responsible reporting destination/key and review dependency/integration notices. Operational deployment and data publication require separate authorization.

issues.title: Add organization-owned NetBox read-only sources
issues.body: Implemented for operator-approved organization-owned NetBox sources: the same four-type importer projects directly into the common organization-scoped Asset model with an independent key and tenant/dedicated scope. GET-only in both access modes; no central NetBox duplication or bidirectional synchronization. Broader source onboarding and deployed-version validation remain separate.

issues.title: Add SBOM, endpoint imports and delegated providers
issues.body: Reuse software identity boundaries and source provenance; scanner/agent/SBOM imports with isolation and explicit grants. Scanning remains separate authorization.
